text.en: Tenebria and Rhythm
[Unique] [Opener] Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards. Create and give each ally 2 of their own Rhythm in Draw Pile. Apply Haste to Rhythm cards of this unit.

body.en:
Tenebria's gimmick is Music, Start! which Exhausts
ALL ALLY (Inlcudes self) BASIC ATTACKS not Basic Skills
Regardless of how many Basics it exhausts you ALWAYS GET 6 Rhythms
(Characters with 2 Basic Attacks save 40 FM, Characters with 1 only 20 FM)
Main problem of Tenebria's Gimmick is how she adds/converts 6 extra cards
That means the Cycle Requirement of Tenebria teams is much higher then avg
Rhythm's created by Tenebria are all considered Basics
That means that Basic Potentials, Mei Move and Rei/Narja synergize
Tenebria Arpeggio (EZ Mode)

Only Rhythm version that stays only as Tenebria's cards
If you draw arp 0/1 you can chain into the rest of them
0->1, 1->2&3, 2->3, 3->4/5, then you only need to draw 4/5 to finish all 6
Total AP = 1 (arp 2)
1->0&2 0->3 2->3, 3->4/5, Total AP = 2 (arp 1&2)
Nia is really good at searching for arp 0&1 while also shuffling away for arp 3
TLDR Arpeggio is actually only Cycle -2 and 1/2 AP

text.en: Cycle -11 | Arpeggio Spotlight | AP -1 | FM 160
[Unique] [Opener] Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards. Create 1 of each Rhythm: Arpeggio in Draw Pile.
[Retain] [Haste] 700% Damage. If in hand, also treat as a Rhythm card. When a Rhythm card is activated, decrease Cost of this card by 1 until this card is activated.
120% Damage. If the last card activated was a Rhythm card, proc that card 2 times.
2 Vulnerable to the target.

body.en:
Its just Arpeggio + Spotlight synergy
Just play out your Arpeggios like normal
Then when you Spotlight pick 5->4->1
It will force 1 into your hand, which you then can use to get 4&5
If the AP requirement of 1 is too high
Spotlight 5->1->0
Draws 0->1->5 0 AP required because of discount on Arp 1
CnR is just here to help with early cycle + buff Arpeggio by counting as a 7th Rhythm
You will end up playing a total of 20 Rhythms, most of them being the Arpeggio 4/5

note.en: Tell me you have bad design without telling me, look here and also Encore 2, like hello?

body.en:
Only Remove Basic Shield, cuz Basic Attacks are removed by Music, Start!
Max is 10x 100%/150% 1000% dmg, only boosted by moral, no card based buffs
Why is this thing not an Upgrade? and giving it an arbitrary cap

Cresc(endo): 7 AP to use all the Rhythms, but no additional requirement like Staccato
Stacc(ato): 6 AP to play them all, but the requirement is to space uses
Fort(issimo): Pretty hard to use, both hand size/draw and AP wise, but ig with Draw Heide its interesting
Ferm(ata): Basically just 1 AP to draw 2 Rhytmns, the go to version if not Arp
Arp(eggio): Whole Section Above, TLDR Unmatcched Cycle/AP Requirement, lower dmg ceiling
(Have to test Fortissimo + Activation)

CnR 1:Cycle +2 as well as counts as a Rhythm to buff, but lowkey can break Arpeggio chains
CnR 2: Basically just free damage, but not very interesting otherwise
CnR 3: Cycle +2 at best, Cycle +1 at worse, but no damage buffing unlike CnR 1
CnR 4: 6 hits equivalent, but the downside is it isn't actually card activations for Hugo/Lena/Cass
CnR 5: Counts as a Rhythm to buff, and is alow just a 0 cost big damage, but -1 Cycle or you Retain it
CnR 0: Also not that bad to just get a Moral Epiphany

Spotlight 1: Good with Rhythm 0, and okay with Crescendo, the others, not so much interesting
Spotlight 2: Basically 1 free Rhythm draw each turn, not very impresive
Spotlight 3: Moves 2 Rhythms but also Activates both, only that 2 Cost is a high upfront expense
Spotlight 4: Move 3 Rhythms from anywhere to Top of Draw pile, then draw 1, umazing
Spotlight 5: 0 cost Draw 2, but discards non Rhythms, its okay
Spotlight 0: Actually not too bad, to just get a Moral Epiphany on this
